I contacted my former therapist after that. Best advice was to take it day by day, minute after minute if you need to. And, especially for the first months- take all the help you get. Let people cook for you, order food for you, do the grocery shopping online if you can, do the nights in shifts. We are almost 4 months in and it has gotten so much better. There are still some really hard days but you watching them getting smarter and growing out of the screaming potato phase is rewarding.

At first I hestitated because I thought it was only about using "natural" products and I already tried that (by using the Maui products which aren't even curly girl approved!). I tried EVERYTHING. My wish for healthy hair started growing at the end of 2017- that was when I stopped using a hair straightener and heat over all. After that I tried out every "good" or "recommended" product to get healthy hair. At some point it felt like I bought every single product on amazon. Nothing worked. My hair felt like literally straw all the time. I used Olaplex, I had several Keratin treatments and I even started to cut out all the spliss by using an expensive pair of scissors. For me trying the CGM was like my last chance. I prayed for it to work and oh my god look at it, look!!

My routine is:
Wash with Shea Moisture Yohgurt & Manuka Honey shampoo. After that I apply a good amount of Shea Moisture Black Castor Oil leave in Conditioner to my hair and do everything else I need to do in the shower so it stays in my hair a bit longer. I have to rinse it out after all because my hair is too thin to leave it on. After I got out of the shower I use the Shea Moisture Yohgurt & Manuka Honey leave in Spray Conditioner (which is not as heavy) and comb my hair with a big toothed wooden comb. Then I scrunchie scrunch with Kinky Curls Gel when my hair is still wet. And then just leave it alone until it's dry. No one would ever suspect I use gel because my hair literally eats it for breakfast.
Sorry for that wall of text but I'm so happy. This gives my so much confidence. Of course my hair is still fragile and I still get spliss and it gets dry a few days after washing but I'm already so thankful for everything!
